title: Day/night biased sampling with overlapping stations and an empty stratum
description: Two blocks with identical true calling rates. West stations listen around the clock (and their hearing ranges overlap, so effort must not be double-counted); every east station shuts down at night and declares the gap. Raw counts say west calls twice as much; the comparable sample shows the day rates are equal and the east night rate is unknown. The reference composition also names mudflat, which no east station can hear: an empty stratum that must be disclosed, never zero-filled.

expected.note: 24 west events (day+night) + 12 east day events; east night calls are lost
